decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. It deliberately accelerates only obstacle-free curves; do not claim faster laps, preserved completion, SOTA or submission readiness until an authorized controlled multi-track evaluation passes the stability-first gate.

Replace the clear-curve target clip(52-3*sweep,30,48) with clip(68/sqrt(1+0.10*raw_sweep),40,64). Straight target68 and gas0.18/0.135/0.09 remain unchanged.
On a clear curve, use steering-budgeted gas0.14/0.11/0.07 below target, coast from target through target+2, then brake clip(0.04+0.012*excess,0.04,0.18).
Store the final post-steering-cap target before pedal adjustment, preserving the inherited target44 whenever abs(pre-clipped steering)>0.28.

Keep current-obstacle targets47/40, obstacle+sweep>=6 target30 and all parent pedals unchanged. A frame that begins with an obstacle miss latch remains parent-exact even when that frame clears the latch.
Preserve road/obstacle perception, steering, pass-side state, action interface, model and all non-bare policy routes.

residual_risks: No authorized driving run measured whether the more aggressive clear-curve envelope preserves completion on unseen tracks.
The raw visible-row sweep is image-space curvature rather than metric radius, distance or tire friction; the inverse-square-root schedule is a bounded proxy.
The requested two-to-two-and-a-half-times overall speed cannot be inferred from gas or target constants. Actual lap-time improvement requires controlled telemetry.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, and the competition website is inaccessible; official evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
